About this course

This course will help students develop an understanding of the fundamentals of public speaking and persuasion in Arabic. Students will learn how to speak confidently and effectively as well as deliver a persuasive message in a variety of public speaking situations. Particular attention will be paid to elements of ethics, delivery persuasion, research, and use of technology in public speaking.
